intent: Single tiny flat 2D sparkle accent that floats beside the 3D hero mascot. Matches KursoKo RIASEC edu sticker language — playful, not dominant.

output.framing: single sparkle centered with ~8px safe padding on all sides

prompt:
Single flat vector 4-point yellow sparkle star for Filipino education app KursoKo. Exactly ONE star centered in frame.

STYLE: 2D flat edu sticker icon — crisp die-cut vector look, NOT 3D, NOT realistic, NOT emoji blur. 2px dark outline #2D2D2D on all outer points. Flat fill #FFD54F with optional one lighter facet #FFE082 on a single point only.

SHAPE: simple cheerful four-point sparkle, slightly asymmetric OK, playful tiny accent — readable at 32px.

BACKGROUND: transparent PNG, no white canvas, no glow bloom, no drop shadow, no halo.

OUTPUT: 64×64 square, ~8px safe padding, sharp crisp edges.
negative_prompt: 3D render, bevel, emboss, realistic, metallic, lens flare, glow bloom, outer halo, drop shadow, blur, soft raster, multiple stars, cluster of stars, text, character, face, emoji style, SaaS icon, neon, cyber, white background, colored background, gradient background, orange star, large composition
